brief:
At the United Nations, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu faced international delegations and accused them of cowardice, Shehab Wire reported. The confrontation drew comparison to declarations of arrogance and supremacy, marking an escalation in his rhetoric before the global body.

The exchange occurred as tensions between Israel and the international community intensify, with diplomatic forums increasingly becoming venues for direct confrontation rather than negotiated dialogue.

title: Netanyahu calls world delegates cowards at UN platform
